Container.Name: kw-ingress
Container.Overview: Inbound gateway for the KW edge (kw-ingress): a stock Caddy that serves the keystone and tape hostnames behind the public reverse proxy, and refuses everything it does not name. NO HOST PORT: this container publishes none and has no Port Config; it listens on port 80 on its own address on the host's LAN, a second network that System Admin attaches. NETWORK: Network stays bridge in this template, because a template cannot create a network; set Network to the internal Docker network the operator created by hand before the first start. Its second leg is the host's LAN network, re-attached by System Admin's host watcher (network.md rule 7), not by this template. No other KW container has a second network. CONFIG: the Caddyfile is mounted read-only from the host, and the environment Variables below carry every site value (hostnames, origins, client ranges, the trusted proxy, the peer allowance). All of them ship blank and must be set before the gateway can serve anything; a blank value refuses the route it guards. HEALTH CHECK: set it by hand in Extra Parameters, System Admin's value: wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1/kw-health, answered to loopback only. RESOURCE LIMITS: CPU and memory are System Admin's per-instance values, recorded in this Overview. IMAGE: caddy:2.11.7 pinned by digest, the same pin as kw-edge's pins.json.
Container.Description: Inbound gateway for the KW edge: routes the keystone and tape hostnames, refuses the rest. Publishes no host port; it has its own address on the host's LAN, attached by System Admin. Every site value is a blank Variable set at creation.

Config.Name: Caddyfile directory
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory holding kw-edge's config/caddy/Caddyfile, mounted read-only at /etc/caddy. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-ingress/caddy. The gateway reads the file at start; reload it with caddy reload, not by restarting.

Config.Name: KW_TRUSTED_PROXY
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Space-separated addresses whose X-Forwarded-For is believed: the public reverse proxy and every tunnel connector that can carry the route, e.g. <reverse-proxy-address> <connector-address>. Read each from the ingress's own log, never from docker inspect. Blank: no forwarded address is trusted and every browser is refused (403).

Config.Name: KW_REMOTE_ALLOW
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Space-separated TCP peers that may reach this container at all: the public reverse proxy, the legacy LAN apps and the workstation, e.g. <peer-address-or-range>. Blank: every request is refused (403) except the loopback health path.

Config.Name: KW_KEYSTONE_HOST
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host header name(s) of the keystone hostname, space separated, e.g. <keystone-host-name>. Blank: the keystone routes answer 404.

Config.Name: KW_TAPE_HOST
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host header name(s) of tape, space separated: the public name and any LAN name the legacy apps use, e.g. <tape-public-name> <tape-lan-name>. Blank: the tape routes answer 404.

Config.Name: KW_WEB_ORIGIN
Config.Description: REQUIRED. keystone-web's origin as address:port, e.g. <keystone-web-address>:<port>. Blank: the keystone routes answer 503.

Config.Name: KW_API_ORIGIN
Config.Description: REQUIRED. tape's origin as address:port, e.g. <tape-address>:<port>. Blank: the tape routes answer 503.

Config.Name: KW_WEB_CLIENTS
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Client ranges allowed on the keystone pages and tape's public paths, matched on the real browser address, e.g. <client-range>. Blank: those routes answer 403 to every client.

Config.Name: KW_ADMIN_CLIENTS
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Client ranges allowed on tape's /v1/admin, matched on the real browser address, e.g. <admin-client-range>. Blank: those routes answer 403 to every client.

Config.Name: KW_API_CLIENTS
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Client ranges allowed on tape's credentialed consumer API (the legacy apps, the Finances client) and on keystone-web's /api/health (LAN monitoring), e.g. <lan-client-range>. Blank: those routes answer 403 to every client.
